THE WHOLE PAGE IS A TWO-WAY BRANCH AND ONLY ONE SIDE IS MODELLED. Rhapsodies 1-1 makes you pick Selbina or Mhaura, and that choice is fixed for the rest of chapter 1; this mission is the same conversation in whichever town you picked. Bullet 1 is the Selbina side -- Naillina at (F-9) in the Mayor's Residence, first option 'You wanted an adventurer?'. Bullet 2 is the Mhaura side -- Numi Adaligo at (F-9) in the Governor's House, first option "You're searching for adventurers?". You do EXACTLY ONE of them.

I modelled the Selbina side only, for the same reason Aht Urhgan Mission 2 in this corpus refused to turn its six staging points into a group: `group` means 'do all of these in any order', which is a different and false claim, and drawing both would put a marker in a town half the players have no business in -- a wrong marker that sends somebody somewhere, which the project ranks as worse than no marker. Selbina wins the coin toss because chronicle already carries 'naillina', so writing it changes nothing at all; writing Numi Adaligo would silently move the marker across the Selbina-Mhaura ferry.

A Mhaura-path player therefore gets a marker one zone away from the right one. That is the cost, it is recorded here rather than hidden, and it is why this is medium and not high. The two towns are a five-minute boat ride apart and the NPC is the town leader in both, so the reading is still useful; nothing about it is a misreading of the page.
